name: Update a list
description: Update a list. Update an existing contact list identified by its ID. You can update the list name, move it to a different folder by providing a new folderId, or both. Only one of the two parameters (name, folderId) needs to be provided per request.

folderId.description: Id of the folder in which the list is to be moved. Either of the two parameters (name, folderId) can be updated at a time.

name.description: Name of the list. Either of the two parameters (name, folderId) can be updated at a time.

execution.auth: API key in the api-key header, or OAuth 2.0. Not included here.
